snippet.title: Acme Widget in 2026 — honest review after 6 months
snippet.description: I've been running acme widget for half a year across two client projects. The good: dashboard speed, the new API. The bad: pricing jumped 40% and the mobile app still can't edit charts.

snippet.title: Acme announces Widget 3.0 with realtime collaboration
snippet.description: Coverage of this week's launch event: realtime multi-user editing, a plugin marketplace, and a new free tier.
